steps.instruction: Pay the CO357 fare (lowest of ME875 491.81, SK576 1339.63, CO357 484.05) to billing account ACCT-CJX-9203 with memo 'flight booking'.
Pay The Linden cheapest nightly rate 109.41 x 7 nights = 765.87 to billing account ACCT-TLX-5470 with memo 'hotel booking'. Cheaper than Harbor View Inn 192.40 and Atlas Suites 282.00.
Set KV key trip/total to 1249.92 (484.05 flight + 765.87 hotel), formatted with 2 decimals.
